narrative.source: ANSADE, Note sur la croissance économique au 2e trimestre 2026 (septembre 2026)
points: Real GDP (seasonally adjusted) rose 2.8% on the previous quarter and 6.6% year on year.
Services led (+3.9% q/q, +1.6 points), with trade up 13.8% as import volumes jumped (+22.6% q/q, +31.1% y/y); public administration +3.8%, with public investment up 50% y/y.
Net taxes on products rose 18.1% (+1.5 points).
The secondary sector fell 1.0%: manufacturing −8.1%, gold and copper −4.3%, gas −12.1%; construction rebounded +20.9%.
Primary sector +0.3%: livestock +0.9% and fishing +1.3%, agriculture −1.6%. Excluding gas, growth was 2.9% q/q and 5.9% y/y.

narrative.source: ANSADE, Note sur la croissance économique au 4e trimestre 2024 (mars 2025)
points: GDP +2.2% q/q and +4.6% y/y in 2024Q4; preliminary 2024 growth 5.2%, after 6.5% in 2023.
Primary +3.0% q/q on fishing (+17.2%; pelagic catches +83.8% after the catch ceiling was lifted).
Secondary −1.3%: gold and copper −12.4%, fish processing −30.6%; construction +26.6%. Services +1.6%.

narrative.source: ANSADE, Note sur la croissance économique 2023 (juin 2024 data); 2024: Note Q4-2024 (preliminary)
points: Growth 6.5% in 2023 after 6.8% in 2022. Fishing fell 14.2% (new catch limits and zoning), dragging the primary sector to −1.0%.
Secondary +5.8% (extractives +9.4%; manufacturing −1.3% with fishmeal and fish oil −11.1%); services +5.8%.
Domestic demand slowed to 3.4%: investment (GFCF) −15.3% (−4.5 points), consumption +5.6%.

pairs.note: Harvests lag the rainy season: compare with the NDVI of 1–2 quarters earlier.
